events.name: journey_step_shown

events.name: journey_step_finished
events.purpose: A journey step ended, coarsened to its outcome and elapsed bucket

events.name: journey_error_shown

events.name: journey_step_reversed
events.purpose: A confirmed step was undone, coarsened to how soon after confirming

events.name: correction_finished
events.purpose: A correction flow ended, saved or discarded

events.name: recovery_started
events.purpose: A recovery path was entered after a failure or lockout

events.name: recovery_finished
events.purpose: A recovery path ended, coarsened to its outcome

events.name: comprehension_check_answered
events.purpose: An optional in-flow comprehension check was answered, coarsened to understood or not

events.name: milestone_reached
events.purpose: A progress milestone was reached, by milestone kind only

events.name: permission_request_answered
events.purpose: A system permission request was answered

events.name: assistant_explanation_opened
events.purpose: An assistant explanation of a figure was opened

events.name: subscription_change_confirmed
events.purpose: A subscription change was confirmed, by change kind only

events.name: share_offer_accepted
events.purpose: A sharing or access grant offer was accepted, by scope only

events.name: shared_access_revoked
events.purpose: A sharing or access grant was revoked, coarsened to how soon

events.name: support_route_opened
events.purpose: A help or support route was opened from a journey
